skeleton._comment: `goblin_encounter_2` (28,18) and `chieftains_raid` (31,7) are unaffected (interact-only, no trigger_radius) and sit well outside this zone.
skeleton._comment_freezable: Freezing (10,17) makes the blocked pond edge walkable, reaching the otherwise inaccessible cache at (10,18); sleep thaws it.
skeleton._comment_unsteady: [Even Footing] chute up the east outcrop. (31,4)-(31,6) were ALREADY blocked, so blocked_cells and every route are unchanged. Scree-dressed, not masonry. NOT the pond -- a warrior on open water reads wrong.
skeleton._cover_skip_comment: cover_skip must move with the inn facade; it prevents generic blocked tiles showing through transparent roofline pixels.

decor._comment: Scree at legible scale (findings 4/15). Suppresses the biome blocked-prop so the chute reads as rocky ground.

entities._hide_comment: Hide the generic door sprite because facade decor owns this cell; door interaction is unchanged.

entities._comment: GH#185 (user ruling): the inn facade's interaction surface widens -- interacting anywhere along the front enters instead of 'Nothing there'. Same transition as floodplains_inn_door; cell stays in the blocked set (doors block by entity, these are interact-only facade cells).

GH#185 (user ruling): the inn facade's interaction surface widens -- interacting anywhere along the front enters instead of 'Nothing there'. Same transition as floodplains_inn_door; cell stays in the blocked set (doors block by entity, these are interact-only facade cells).
the sign's wording lives ONLY in the toast/observe copy below, by design (the art carries no baked text).
entities.observe: The paint is newer than the post it hangs on. Somebody meant it, and means it still.
entities.toast: A hand-painted board, letters gone bold where they were traced twice: THE WANDERING INN — NO KILLING GOBLINS.

entities._comment: b7 #214c: the fishing affordance — an item-gated bank prop beside the freezable pond edge ((10,17) itself stays clear for the freeze mechanic). No catch item, no fishing system (CHOICE-LOG): the issue is affordance clarity; banks went_fishing, once per waking. The handline's own lore ('the water starts moving wrong') is the deliberate echo.
entities.item_hint_toast: Whatever's under there won't come to bare hands. Lism's shelf had a fisher's handline.
entities.observe: The pond narrows here over a drop the light doesn't reach. Every so often the water moves wrong, and then it stops, the way a room stops when you walk into it. Whatever keeps this water is not interested in being caught.
entities.once_per_waking_toast: The water's gone still. Whatever considered you today is done considering.
entities.toast: You pay out the line into the dark water. Nothing takes it, and nothing was ever going to — whatever keeps this pool knows the difference between an offer and a hook.

entities._comment: Interact-only, banks `found_the_frozen_cache` (opaque) + a flavor toast.
entities.observe: Something square and man-made rests on the pond floor a stride out from the bank, furred with silt. Too far to reach across open water. But water can be made to bear weight, if you know the trick of cold.
entities.toast: Kneeling on the ice, you lever the silt-caked strongbox free. Drake-work, old, its lock long rusted through. Inside, dry against all odds, a few keepsakes someone drowned here meant never to be found.

variants.toast: The strongbox sits open and empty now, holding nothing but pond-light.

entities._comment: record_accomplishment is idempotent for gate purposes (>= 1).
GH#185: the city gate is wider than one cell -- flanking cells share the transition (same on_enter bank; record_accomplishment idempotent).
GH#185: the city gate is wider than one cell -- flanking cells share the transition (same on_enter bank; record_accomplishment idempotent).

entities.friendly_line: Heh. Alright, alright - I like you. You've got the look of someone who buys a guy a drink after. We're good, you and me. Best guardsman in Liscor says so.
entities.observe: A Drake built like a barracks door, spear worn smooth from use, standing at ease the way only dangerous people stand. He watches the road and everyone on it. Including you, now.

talk_pool_stages._comment: GH#186: the post-spar sleep nudge, durable (the victory toast is transient). Earliest-gated stage: every later stage outranks it as the story advances.

entities.observe: Straw and burlap lashed to posts, hacked half to ribbons. Someone drills here often, and hard. The stitching tells you where a real guard would break.
entities.victory_toast: Relc whistles. "Not bad for a start. Now go SLEEP on it — Classes come at the pillow, not the podium. Bed's upstairs at the inn."

entities.locked_toast: A cairn on a hill. The view is mostly weather.

on_skill_use.toast: [Eagle Eyes] — The plains resolve: the gate road, the ruin east past it, and every fold of dead ground a warband could hide in. You'll walk this land differently now.

entities.skill_hint_toast: From up here the floodplains pretend to be a map. Good eyes could read it.

entities._comment: LOCKED interface: entry door id `ruin_door` (this entity) pairs with `ruin_exit` on ruin_surface. Task 2.3 moved the door_when gate door_chain_started -> horns_dig_started. MANDATORY, not cosmetic: Task 2.2 retired door_chain_started's only producer and Task 2.4 re-banks it at the MOUNTING (which needs door_retrieved, which needs this door), so the old gate would have deadlocked the seam shut forever for every new save. Old saves reach horns_dig_started through Task 2.6's backfill.

door_when.open_toast: The seam splits wider at your touch, cold air breathing out of the dark beneath. You step through, into somewhere else.

entities.observe: A hairline crack runs through old, dressed stone half-swallowed by turf — not natural rock, something built. Cold air breathes up out of it, and it smells of somewhere else.
entities.toast: A cold seam splits the earth here, sealed by old stone. It doesn't feel like it goes anywhere. Yet.

entities._comment: `allies`/`ally_requires` mirror every other floodplains fight (goblin_encounter_1/2, chieftains_raid): Relc fields once met_relc is banked, solo before that.
entities.observe: Three boulders sit too evenly spaced for the hillside's own tumble, and one of them, you'd swear, just shifted.
entities.tame_refusal_toast: The crab regards you with all the tameable warmth of a boulder.

entities.gate_closed_toast: Nothing moving out there. Whatever it was keeps day hours, same as everyone sane.
entities.observe: A patrol slipping the boulder line, quiet until they're not. Only after dark.

visual_states._comment: Marker visible ONLY while the night encounter_when gate can fire

entities._comment: respawns:true (dormant until the next sleep, the rock_crab_nest/river_wolf_pack mechanism).
entities.observe: A shape stands too still at the treeline, antlers catching a warmth that isn't sunlight.
A scrape of trampled grass, two long-beaked shapes hunched low over it, watching you watch them.

entities._comment: GH#156 [Beast Tamer] entry producer. First careful visit banks soothed_a_beast (partial taming counts -- a hurt bee and Lyonette, 3.23 L); the variant flips later visits to tended_beasts, the curve counter. once_per_waking gates BOTH paths (interact and the beasts_mending cast share the serve: key -- one careful visit per waking total). Also a beasts_mending cast target via requires_skill/on_skill_use.
entities._comment_330: #330 R3: at tended_beasts 10 it STANDS; the next tend banks corusdeer_healed and it goes home. Shipped strings untouched.
entities.observe: A corusdeer, down in the grass with a leg it won't put weight on. Its antlers barely glow. It watches you the way anything hurt watches anything larger. It would let patient hands close, and hands that tend enough hurt beasts learn something no drill yard teaches.

on_skill_use.toast: [Beast's Mending] — Splint and salve, and the leg sits straighter than it has any right to. The corusdeer breathes easier.

variants.toast: [Beast's Mending] — The splint comes away and stays away. It stands, tests the leg, and goes to find the herd. Your hands knew what to do because of this deer.

entities.once_per_waking_toast: It has let you close once today. Don't spend what little trust it has.
entities.toast: You move slow, keep your hands low, and it lets you check the leg. That, from a wild thing, is everything.

variants.toast: It knows you now. It holds still while you work, and its antlers warm the air between you.
It is already standing when you come. It lets you run a hand down the leg once, then turns and goes up the rise at a trot, and does not look back.

entities._comment_330: #330 R3: what the deer leaves behind. The antler is a ONE-TIME pickup on the frozen_cache variant-zeroing pattern.
entities.observe: A body-shaped hollow pressed into the grass, going green again at the edges. Something lay here a long time, and then stopped needing to.
entities.toast: In the flattened grass, shed clean at the base: one antler, oaken-brown fading to a red glow at the tip. It is warm to hold, and stays warm.

variants.toast: Only the hollow in the grass now, and it is filling in.

entities._comment: GH#156 [Lesser Bond] tame target. companion_source routes through the generalized _animate_field seam; the skill-unknown path falls to use_skill's locked_toast.

companion_source.taken_toast: The pup sniffs your hand once, twice — then leans its whole small weight against your leg. That's that, then.

entities.locked_toast: The pup shrinks back. You don't have the hands for this yet — hands like that are learned on hurt animals, one at a time. There's a corusdeer down in the grass east of here that would let you start.
entities.observe: A scrape under the boulder line, and in it one wolf pup, ribs showing, too young to be alone. The pack that left it is not coming back.
entities.skill_hint_toast: It watches your hands. Whatever you mean to offer it, offer it properly.

entities._comment: GH#156 [Lesser Bond] tame target (razorbeak chick).

companion_source.taken_toast: It bites you exactly once, decides you took it well, and climbs your sleeve to glare at the horizon from a better vantage.

entities.locked_toast: It snaps at your fingers. Fair enough. Nothing wild takes an offer from hands that have never tended anything.
entities.observe: A razorbeak chick, blown or chased from the nest scrape, hissing at the whole world from behind a tussock. The nest is close. The parents are not.
entities.skill_hint_toast: It stops hissing when you crouch. Interested, then — if you make the offer the right way.

entities._comment: GH#332 SPRING LITTER, rung 1 of 3. Tame props are consumed permanently, so a re-bond needs its own row. A rung opens on one more `companion_lost` (banked ONLY by a TAMED downed-clear) and NEVER closes on a counter -- a counter `absent` erased rungs nobody visited. Being TAKEN retires it (`removed_entities`), so rungs COEXIST on distinct cells. `companion: ""` = empty slot.

companion_source.taken_toast: It walks out of the scrape without being asked and stands on your foot. The pack keeps its own counsel about who leaves with whom.

entities.locked_toast: The pup watches you the way it watches weather. Hands that can take an offer like this are learned on hurt animals, one at a time.
entities.observe: The scrape under the boulder line has been dug out again and re-lined. A season on, and there is a pup in it: bolder than the last one, and entirely unimpressed by you.
entities.skill_hint_toast: It has not learned to be afraid of hands yet. Make the offer before it does.

entities._comment: GH#332 SPRING LITTER, rung 2 of 3 -- the razorbeak arm, so the ladder is not one pup thrice. See `wolf_den_spring`.

companion_source.taken_toast: It stalks the length of your arm, finds the shoulder acceptable, and settles there facing backwards. Somebody has to watch the way you came.

entities.locked_toast: It flares its hackles and holds the tussock. Nothing wild takes an offer from hands that have never tended anything.
entities.observe: The nest scrape has fledged another. This one has already worked out that the tussock is cover and that you are not, and it is holding both facts against you.
entities.skill_hint_toast: It goes still when you crouch, which from a razorbeak is an invitation. Make the offer properly.

entities._comment: GH#332 SPRING LITTER, rung 3 of 3 -- TOP RUNG. Own cell one south of rung 1: all three can stand at once. See `wolf_den_spring`.

companion_source.taken_toast: It leans, the way the first one leaned. You are not being given a replacement. You are being given another one.

entities.locked_toast: The pup does not move. Hands that can take an offer like this are learned on hurt animals, one at a time.
entities.observe: Late in the season and thin with it, but another scrape further down the boulder line is occupied. Whatever else the floodplains do, they keep doing this.
entities.skill_hint_toast: It is too tired to flinch. Offer, and mean it.

entities._comment: b1 #199 'The Chieftain's Price'. Conversation-first (NO trigger radius — she waits; interact opens rags_meeting; combat only via the betrayal close's start_combat). present_when = the composed conduct+relationship gate (design doc 2026-07-19-b1-rags-design.md section 2; absent arm = never hunted the camp). Interim sprite: rags registry entry reuses the goblin_chieftain sheet reduced+tinted until the c3 bespoke (VISUAL-LOG row). Finding 18: present_when mirrors the encounter requires -- she does not STAND on the rise before the Erin gate; STAYS post-settle (farewell re-talk is pinned, rags_meeting_loop).
entities.gate_closed_toast: The small figure on the rise watches you. It does not move to meet you.
entities.observe: A small figure on the rise south, standing very still. It has been watching you for a while, and it wants you to know that.

entities._comment: v0.16 F1 (#308). TRAP: door_when is requires-ONLY, so the peaceful gate's absent arm has to live on present_when -- a betrayal win banks rags_meeting_settled too.

door_when.open_toast: You go down between the stones sideways, the way the flattened grass says to, and the plains close over the top of you.

entities.observe: Two low stones lean together where the ground folds away, and the grass between them is beaten flat by small feet. Smoke comes up thin and does not spread.

entities._comment: Finding 16: stood on the road ALL DAY as an invisible blocking square ('come back at night'). present_when phase-gates EXISTENCE (safe since GH#392); by day the verge is empty ground. encounter_when stays as the night arm.
entities.gate_closed_toast: The road's empty in the daylight. Whatever works this verge keeps to the dark.
entities.observe: Two heavy shapes working the verge of the wagon road, wings folded tight, close enough to the carter camps to smell the fires. Only after dark.

entities._comment: #330 R4: present only while the wolf rides. One-time find, frozen_cache shape, no gold.
entities.observe: A scatter of old bones the wolf will not leave alone. It noses through them, circles, noses again, and looks back at you as though the next part is your job.
entities.toast: You dig where the wolf keeps insisting. Under the bones, wrapped in rotted cloth: a charm on a cord gone soft with age.

variants.toast: Turned bones and nothing under them now. The wolf has lost interest, which is its own verdict.

entities._comment: #330 R4: the observe carries the [Observe] payoff; interact is the bird coming back with a lead.
entities.observe: A boulder standing clear of the reeds with the whole pond below it. The razorbeak keeps climbing it and screaming at the water, which is either an opinion or a report.
entities.toast: It wheels out over the pond, hangs, and comes back loud. There is something square and man-made on the bottom, a stride out from the bank — too far to reach across open water, and water can be made to bear weight.

entities._comment: AUTHORED arm only, never a `burnable` tag: flame_jet has no `burns` flag, so no other burnable prop moves. ONE-SHOT via present_when.absent. Off every QA-walked cell, 5 clear of goblin_encounter_1.
entities.locked_toast: The meat is good and it will not stay good. Raw and cold, it is no use to you, and you have no way to change that.
entities.observe: A young corusdeer down in the grass with its neck wrong, cold hours ago and not yet found by anything with teeth. The hide is whole. The haunches are worth carrying, if you had a way to make them keep.

on_skill_use.toast: [Flame Jet] — You run the lance along the haunch until the fat goes loud and the outside blackens. You cut what will travel and leave the rest to the grass.

entities.skill_hint_toast: Hauling at it with your hands gets you nothing. Fire is what this wants.

floor_layers._pick: dry earthen hill brow; the later road layers cut through its south edge

skeleton.unsteady_toast: Scree slides out from under your boot and rattles away down the slope. Getting up that needs surer feet than yours.
